change: Stop vectorized IPF when maximum one-way target error is <=2e-10 instead of pursuing 2e-12, cap iterations at 250, and evaluate four deterministic support candidates per constituency.
rationale: The frozen acceptance gate already requires raking error <=5e-10 and political marginal error <=1e-9. Computing two additional decimal orders does not alter scientific acceptance and only wastes runtime.
failure_rule: Fail closed if no tested support satisfies all original frozen gates.
